source: General LIBERO manipulation lessons, stated in terms of the current RGB-D views and robot proprioception.

lessons.trigger: Images show the fingers aligned around the intended grasp surface.
lessons.strategy: Use one deliberate close and inspect after lifting. A closed jaw alone does not establish retention.

lessons.trigger: Visible objects obstruct a direct approach.
lessons.strategy: Use a visible clear approach, lift relatively before translating when justified by the images, and inspect ambiguous clearance.

lessons.trigger: The visible grasp barely overlaps the object edge.
lessons.strategy: Adjust a small relative offset from the current depth surface while keeping visible supporting surfaces clear.

lessons.trigger: Images show interrupted pushing with little object movement.
lessons.strategy: Maintain the intended visible contact during a bounded stroke and inspect progress. Hidden contact forces are unavailable.

lessons.trigger: A move produces little measured robot displacement or an occluded view.
lessons.strategy: Observe from configured cameras, use small relative adjustments, and replan. Remove only visibly idle pauses; retain needed contact and settling.
Prefer short motion plans and reuse approved recipes. Camera and model waiting time does not spend simulation steps.
